verdict.rationale: Grok is itself an AI assistant. The docs show in-product delegation: Grok Bot lets users 'hand real work to AI teammates on a persistent cloud computer', and chat connectors let Grok act on the user's behalf, such as creating Salesforce records, sending Teams messages, and managing Drive files. Multi-agent research orchestration adds to this, and a community report describes Grok handling an app-building task without micromanagement. One older report of weak agentic tool calling concerns Grok 4 driven through an external harness, not the in-product assistant, so it lowers confidence rather than creating a dispute. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of Grok Bot's delegation workflow (scope, autonomy, task hand-off), independent hands-on corroboration of Grok Bot specifically.
